svg.text: Pins with the same coloured label are wired together. All GND labels connect to one common ground.
turn screw until display reads 5.0 V
Set buck to 5.0 V BEFORE connecting
servos or LCD. Unplug 220 V while
wiring. Never feed 12 V or 5 V into
a GPIO pin. Servos take 5 V from the
pin names as printed: D25 = GPIO25
pins on top edge, left to right
no pot? 1 kΩ from VO to GND works too
aim across the tray; screw sets range
ECHO is 5 V → divide down to 3.3 V
output goes LOW when metal is near
output gives 12 V when metal is near
